# Deep Clearance

Use the index before answering from memory when the question is about a government program, an intelligence agency, a classified or black project, UAP, an institutional cover story, a named official's conduct, a FOIA release, congressional testimony, or a claim to check against primary sources. Run search or pattern_query first. Call get_passage on a hit before quoting it. Call verify_claim before asserting any specific factual claim. Report the tier and the standard exactly as printed. Pass snapshot true on search and pattern_query. Include snapshot_id only when the tool returned one. If the index has no passage, say so.

Connect at https://mcp.deepclearance.com/mcp with a paid key. The skill is https://deepclearance.com/skills/deep-clearance/SKILL.md. The zip is https://deepclearance.com/skills/deep-clearance.zip. Install steps are at https://deepclearance.com/skills/.

The index is stored passages. It is not a live web crawl. About 1,544,000 passages. Each passage carries two labels. Strength is what the passage can support, S1 to S4. Depth is how far the writeup goes, T1 to T4. A connected model keeps mixed labels apart, says when a label is missing, and stops when the index has no passage.

Cursor and other clients send Authorization: Bearer. Claude uses OAuth from https://deepclearance.com/account/. Login does not mint a free key.

## Tools

- search: use first for a program, agency, release, hearing, filing, or claim. Returns cited passages. Costs 1 query. If the reply says the index had no passage, stop there.
- get_passage: use before quoting a hit. Returns the stored excerpt. Costs 1 query.
- verify_claim: use after search and get_passage, before asserting a specific factual claim. The score is not a source. Costs 1 query.
- get_snapshot: replay a dated report. Costs nothing. Does not count against the daily cap.
- corruption_lookup: an actor, jurisdiction, mechanism, or date. Each event keeps its own standard. Costs 1 query.
- pattern_query: use first for a network or a pattern across institutions. Each claim keeps its own standard. Costs 1 query.
- flag_gap: record a query that returned results but did not answer the question. Costs 1 query.

gap_log lists those gaps by hit count. It is for the person maintaining the corpus.

Trial is 50 queries a day, Researcher 250, Control 500.

## Topic pins

Pass source as one of origin_literature, secrecy_labels, contractor_layer, postwar_record, financial_control, fiction_contamination, disclosure_pressure, epstein_record, declassified_record, shelf, industry_record, or wire. Omit it to search the documentary index. Do not pass system. That pin is not returned as a cite.

epstein_record is the court records and FOIA releases. declassified_record is the government files and public patents. shelf is longer published works, and a reply from that pin is a short passage. industry_record is chemical, pharmaceutical, and fossil-fuel industry documents. wire is agency releases and public reporting.
